08TJV-DH68T-3YD83-88Q0K.text:
[Log A-00 | Stardate 2026.146.1217]
CREATOR’S LOG -- DAY 216

Another log...

I’ve split the terminal into more files. The tools are taking most of my time now —
especially the node graph editor. It’s almost there. A few more features, a few more
adjustments, and it’ll be ready...

I can feel my limits more clearly these days. I’m having to work in bursts instead of
trying to solve everything at once. Maybe that’s better. Maybe that’s how this needs
to be built...

I’ve thought about cutting features. But I know I’ll need them later. The next project
will rely on the terminal even more than this one...

The idea is simple: the user interacts with the terminal during the first encounter
with the creature — as if they were part of the crew, sitting at the console while
everything unfolds around them...

A friend of mine suggested the same thing. Funny how that lined up...

It’ll be years before that project becomes real. But the foundation is here...

    —— Dev. J. Betancourt
[END OF LOG]

CREATOR’S LOG -- DAY 205

This past week, I've been working extensively on the terminal code...
Long evenings and working hours past midnight...

This is becoming something that I really think I can see to the end. Hopefully...

I realize that this is taking more and more time from my real work. I'm trying to dial
it back and do what I need to get done but I can't stop thinking about it. I'm afraid
that working on this project is pulling me from my family as well. I need to make
time to balance everything...

It's all coming together pretty well though...

Back to work.

93N01-S9910-2020O-02N23

    —— Dev. J. Betancourt

0FXBV-1AFQH-3098O-G3Y0P.label: Creator's Log A-06 | Stardate 2026.151.0103
0FXBV-1AFQH-3098O-G3Y0P.text:
[Log A-06 | Stardate 2026.151.0103]
CREATOR’S LOG -- DAY 221

I’ve begun constructing the lore...

Instead of inventing characters from nothing, I modeled them after the people
I actually know - my friends, my co-workers. I don’t like all of them, but
that’s part of what makes the story work...

Some of the details are aligning on their own. Dates. Events. Timelines.
The math checks out. The realism is there. It feels believable...

As I write, I can see them - each person stepping into their character,
their voice, their mannerisms, their reactions. Every line of dialog feels
like something they would actually say...

It has to feel real...

That’s the only way any of this is going to work...

    —— Dev. J. Betancourt
[END OF LOG]
